d:
Piem modi ke bihar daure aur nitish setu udghatan ke bad vipaksh ne unke bhashan men kie gae davon par saval uthae.
43 lakh logon ko ghar dene ke dave, bihar men rojgar, gujrat men majduri karne vale bihariyon aur bhrashtachar ko lekar tikha hamla bola.
Nitish kumar ko udghatan samaroh men jagah nahin milne aur bijepi-JDU ke rishton par bhi kya kaha, sunie pura bayan.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
